leakage_mechanisms.risk: Devices from the same paper share base vacuum levels, crucible purity, and substrate contamination, allowing models to learn batch constants.
Flakes mechanically exfoliated from the same bulk crystal share defect density and thickness distribution.
Same probe station, contact probe resistance subtraction, and cryostat thermometer calibration.

conclusion: Standard random K-Fold suffers from 100% fold contamination in our multi-record studies. Grouped cross-validation is mandatory.
